label: Local smoke measurement, not a cloud capacity benchmark

environment.execution: Single Node.js process serving the app and running the load generator on localhost
environment.resource_limits: Not controlled; no dedicated CPU or memory reservation
environment.transport: HTTP loopback, no TLS or external network

observations.percentile_method: nearest rank on sorted completed-request client durations

limitations: One short local run; no production reliability, uptime or maximum throughput is established.
Client and server share a process and host; CPU/memory allocation and noise were not controlled.
Client latency percentiles are computed from completed HTTP samples, not a Prometheus query.
This was a success-path smoke test, not a deliberate error, recovery or resilience exercise.
No Prometheus server, Grafana dashboard or Kubernetes cluster was connected; raw /metrics exposition was captured.
No before/after performance improvement is claimed.
